reviews.text: Rebecca is a hair sculptor!!! She is amazing with Deva cuts and all styles. She will perfectly shape it to your desires, face shape and personality!!!

Always amazing seeing Ashley. Her attention to detail and experience with curly hair has more than improved the quality, look and feel of my curly hair. I highly recommend Ashley and the hair parlour.

Lauren is a straight up color genius - she’s like a voodoo, potion brewing hair witch. She’s also exceptionally considerate, kind and funny! Everyone I interacted with in the salon was so nice. I can’t wait to come back again!
